stem:
Zoya talks about human digestion along the alimentary canal from mouth to anus.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: Digestion breaks complex food components into simpler forms.
This breakdown continues along the alimentary canal from mouth to anus.
Digestion joins simple food substances into more complex ones along the canal.
Digestion is only the chewing of food in the mouth.

teacher.key_rationale: Digestion is breakdown of complex food into simpler forms along the canal from mouth to anus, not joining or mouth-only chewing.
